schema_notes.status: current = on the landing's own fleet page or sportfishingreport landing roster on 2026-10-05; unverified = named in prompt/old reports but NOT on any current landing roster

notes: Primary sources: each landing's own fleet page where it loaded (hmlanding.com/charter-fleet, danawharf.com/our-boats, pierpoint.net/fleet.php, seaforthlanding.com/fleet.php, 22ndstreet.com/fleet.php, channelislandssportfishing.com/charter-boats, venturasportfishing.com/fleet.php, redondosportfishing.com, longbeachsportfishing.org, stardustsportfishing.com, oceanside.fishingreservations.com) plus sportfishingreport.com landing rosters and per-boat charter_boats pages for dimensions/max load.
976-tuna.com could not be fetched (expired TLS certificate), so the cross-check used sportfishingreport.com only.

Landing sites that would not load or had no fleet list: pointlomasportfishing.com (403/404 on fleet pages), fishermanslanding.com/boats/ (404; per-boat .php links exist), helgrensportfishing.com (no fleet page), daveyslocker.com and newportlanding.com (no fleet list), marinadelreysportfishing.com (TLS error), hookslanding.com (empty), sealanding.net (DNS fail). Those landings are covered from sportfishingreport.com pages.

sportfishingreport.com treats the big San Diego long-range boats (Excel, Royal Polaris, Royal Star, Searcher, Shogun, American Angler, Independence, Intrepid, Vagabond, Red Rooster III, Spirit of Adventure) as their own 'landings'; their berth landing here follows the boat's own page/landing site (Fisherman's for the first five, Point Loma for the next four, H&M for the last two). Polaris Supreme berths at Seaforth per seaforthlanding.com/fleet.php.

Capacity figures differ between a landing's marketing page and sportfishingreport's 'max load' (COI) for several boats, e.g. Legend 30 vs 90, Premier 55 vs 90, Ocean Odyssey 35 vs 70, Producer 30 vs 49, Malihini (hmlanding blank) vs 59. The landing figure was preferred when present.

MMSI search policy: one web search per boat with the pattern '<name> sportfishing <port> MMSI' for every boat of roughly 45 ft and up; 6-pack boats under ~45 ft were skipped because they rarely carry Class A/B AIS and name collisions dominate results. Only directory hits matching name + US flag + plausible size were recorded; near-misses are explained in mmsi_note.

MMSIs found: 15 of 165 rows. High confidence (11): Excel, Royal Polaris, Red Rooster III, Intrepid, Independence, Polaris Supreme, Outer Limits, Pacific Dawn, Freelance, Ahra-Ahn, New Del Mar. Medium confidence (4): Spirit of Adventure, Electra, Dana Pride, Stardust. See mmsi_confidence and mmsi_note on each row.
Ranger 85 splits its season between CISCO's (Oxnard) and H&M (San Diego) and is listed once with both landings.
Western Pride is listed under both Davey's Locker and Newport Landing on sportfishingreport (common ownership); listed once here.

Boats flagged status=unverified (Jig Strike, Condor, Outrider, Eclipse, Cee Ray) are included for completeness because they were named in the task or on a landing's own site, but are not on any current fleet roster as of 2026-10-05.
